thread:
Mira: GA live — OpenAPI Streams + Edge-Lite tool-calling are production-ready and rolling out now. Massive thanks to runtime, SDK, and docs teams :tada:
Devin: Awesome. Any breaking changes for existing streaming endpoints?
Mira: Not forced. New projects default to OpenAPI Streams. Existing endpoints can opt-in; migration tool + alias mappings will be available in ~2 weeks.
Devin: How about Dedicated/Private?
Mira: Dedicated: control-plane toggle. Private: patch next week, account teams will coordinate activation.
Sam: Docs and SDKs pushed to staging. Example SSE curl:
```
curl -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/openapi/streams"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-edge-lite","input":"hello"}'
```
Sam: Note: tool-calls in streams require header `X-Redwood-Tool-Call: true` and a `tools` object in payload.
Anna: Migration guide + changelog: https://redwood.ai/docs/openapi-streams/migration. Added multipart vs SSE notes.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot: canary deployed us-east-1 at 2007502520. Early perf: p50 ~55ms, p95 ~180ms. Error rate <0.5% so far. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: release/edge-openapi-streams@prod tag 1.0.0-ga deployed to 3 nodes in us-east-1.
Sam: Compatibility note: default encoder quantization updated for edge-lite — custom kernel builds may show small diffs. See docs note.
Natalie: Marketing preparing blog + changelog, announcing at 12:30pm PT. Please flag blockers.
Mira: @Devin @Anna please triage docs/quickstart fixes. Customer email scheduled for noon PT. :mailbox_with_mail:
Devin: I'll watch dashboards and open an incidents thread if anything spikes.
Anna: Quickstart updated with Postman collection and new SDK snippet.
Mira: Post-launch checklist: confirm alerts, publish SDK release notes, ensure support rotation aware, capture perf telemetry for Optimize. Thanks everyone :rocket:
